review.independentReview: Identity, anatomy, limb separation, compact airborne gather semantics, normalized margins, light/dark visibility, and corrected native Jam Stage captures pass.
review.cleanupPolicy: Crop to largest alpha>=16 component bounds and retain all source RGBA pixels inside those bounds. Uniform nearest-neighbor resample to 51x83; no redraw, recolor, or masking.

normalizedComponentDisposition.connectivity: At alpha>=16, retained normalized cell is one connected silhouette; at alpha>=64, 8-connected analysis is one component. Four-connectivity splits three diagonal edge-touch groups of 2, 2, and 1 pixels.
normalizedComponentDisposition.visualReview: Those threshold-only pixels sit on the silhouette edge and do not appear as detached marks in the 100%/120% native captures or light/dark proof.
normalizedComponentDisposition.decision: Retain unchanged. Do not mask edge pixels; raw source and normalized crop remain preserved.

review.nativeRendererFinding: Superseded: corrected preview injection occurs before game.start() caches production sprites. Corrected current-main Jam Stage captures show the full candidate at 100% and 120% in both facings; see final-100/ and final-120/.
